how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-orgrimmar-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:81:obj:0: Deliver the barrel to Dran Droffers in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:81:details:0: I have taken the extra step of securing not only Dran's packaged ripple in the barrel, but also the extra bottles of ripple he is purloining. While I may not hold Dran very highly, there is nothing worse than jostled ripple. You're welcome.
rows.quest:81:details:1: BNow, deliver yon barrel to Dran Droffers in his salvage emporium in ⟦E1⟧. Pray tell, please extend my warmest greetings to Malton; let him know that should he ever thirst for fine drink and finer drinking companions, we would be honored with his visit.
rows.quest:81:completion:0: Well, let's see what's in this barrel!
rows.quest:81:completion:1: BYes, yes, it looks as though it is all here. Here's your fee for the package, good job on that. I stand to make five times that fee when I sell it to the tavern! Har har!
rows.quest:81:completion:2: BThese extra bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple are going to be set for a special occasion. I think I'll drink some with champagne. I'll call it... champipple.
rows.quest:235:obj:0: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:235:details:0: Attention, young adventurers! The wilds of ⟦E2⟧ await you!
rows.quest:235:details:1: BThe ⟦E3⟧ has established a strong presence in the lands north of the ⟦E4⟧. Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the ⟦E3⟧! Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there. Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the ⟦E4⟧, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:235:completion:0: Welcome to the new frontier, ⟦1⟧. ⟦E2⟧ is a land of opportunity, one where a young ⟦2⟧ like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the ⟦E3⟧ has another outpost there as well.
rows.quest:235:completion:1: BYour presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
rows.quest:649:details:0: I've got some salvage work for you, and if you're an aficionado of fine ripple like I am, then you'll love this task. Ripple!
rows.quest:649:details:2: BAn abandoned ⟦E3⟧ outpost has a stash of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from when they were in business. You can't get fine ripple like that anymore! One of Malton's dummy associates knows the shot, so you'll go out there and bring me a case of packaged ripple, and two for my own collection! Talk to Malton, he'll fill you in on the details.
rows.quest:649:completion:0: Oh yeah, about the ripple dad wants! He wants to sell the ripple to a tavern here in ⟦E1⟧, but we'll get more money if it is in its original packaging. I know someone who can do that, and he's in the Hinterlands where the ripple is. But he's, um, a high elf.
rows.quest:649:completion:1: BWell, he's a good high elf, as he's not a part of the ⟦E5⟧. Well, he's not so much a good high elf as he is a drunken high elf. He loves, and I mean LOVES the hooch.
rows.quest:650:obj:0: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:650:details:0: The elf you will need to talk to is Gilveradin Sunchaser. He can name any wine, vintage and all, just by smell alone! He can package up the ripple we need, so you'll need to talk with him. We need six bottles for packaging, two for dad, and how ever many he'll want... and believe me, he'll want some. When you've packaged the ripple and got dad's two bottles, come back here!
rows.quest:650:details:1: BGilveradin's camp is near some high elf lodge in the Hinterlands, and those high elves are not good. Trust me.
rows.quest:650:completion:0: Ah, so you know Malton? He is an old drinking companion of mine. You see, I have found something that transcends the boundaries of artificial treaties and alliances - alcohol. Were we all to slake our thirsts on its blissful qualities, we all would be in a much better place spiritually.
rows.quest:650:completion:1: BAlas, something tells me that your visit here is not to learn of alcohol's redeeming values, now is it.
rows.quest:936:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:936:details:0: Excuse me ⟦3⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:936:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E7⟧ is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:936:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within ⟦E7⟧ proper.
rows.quest:936:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦4⟧; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.
rows.quest:1018:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of ⟦E7⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1018:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E8⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E9⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1018:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E6⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of ⟦E7⟧ for more information!
rows.quest:1018:completion:1: BI am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.
rows.quest:1018:completion:2: BOur connection with the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E10⟧ transcends racial and political divides. Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.
rows.quest:1146:obj:0: Deliver Belgrom's Sealed Note to Moktar Krin in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1146:details:0: So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.
rows.quest:1146:details:1: BA few days ago a hunter returned to me from ⟦E11⟧ nearly dead. He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.
rows.quest:1146:details:2: BThey were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. Bring him this note.
rows.quest:1146:completion:0: Don't mind the thundering echoes off the mountains' walls. The goblins and gnomes are out among the Flats racing one another in atrocities created by what they call science. There are bigger threats here in ⟦E11⟧, one of which killed more than half my war party.
rows.quest:1146:completion:1: BBut we remain here until we hear word from Belgrom in ⟦E1⟧. Until then, we hold our position here, and stay vigilant.
rows.quest:1431:details:0: Be still, ⟦6⟧, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.
rows.quest:1431:details:1: BWe are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.
rows.quest:1431:details:2: BIf the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
rows.quest:1431:completion:0: ⟦7⟧, noble ⟦8⟧. I am Keldran, student of magic... and other mystical arts.
rows.quest:1431:completion:1: BThe business Craven sent you here to speak to me about requires a touch more subtlety than you've previously needed, but that does not mean you can not still aid our cause.
rows.quest:1431:completion:2: BPlease, make yourself comfortable, and I shall tell you why the Warchief has need of my aid... and yours.
rows.quest:1431:completion:3: BIt starts with appearances, ⟦9⟧. How the ⟦E3⟧ sees itself. How our allies see us. And most importantly, how our enemies see us.
rows.quest:1432:details:0: As the ⟦E5⟧ progresses deeper and deeper into ⟦E8⟧, incorrect conclusions may be drawn about the ⟦E3⟧ making pacts with the ⟦E13⟧. The Warchief cannot allow that to happen. And with his blessing, I am taking control of overseeing them removed.
rows.quest:1432:details:1: BI have agents in the area of ⟦E12⟧ at the Ghost Walker Post north of the great Kodo Graveyard. Head south of the Charred Vale in the ⟦E14⟧ and you shall come across it. When you arrive, seek out Takata Steelblade.
rows.quest:1432:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦10⟧. You bring news from ⟦E1⟧; that is good.
rows.quest:1432:completion:1: BThe demon infestation overwhelms this area even more than the smell of centaur dung. The horse-men claim this land as their own, but clearly there are influences out of their control that will crush them if not kept in check.
rows.quest:1432:completion:2: BIt does not please me that we aid the centaur indirectly, but it is for the good of the ⟦E3⟧, so I do my duty for the Warchief, even if it means helping the warlocks within the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1433:details:0: The Burning Blade have many agendas, but know that they are evil to their core, their spirits corrupted, and their destruction is the only way to thwart their objectives.
rows.quest:1433:details:1: BKeldran sent Maurin with me because of his knowledge of the Blade and their warlock ways.
rows.quest:1433:details:2: BHe has control of our plots against the Blade while I deal with the other demonic threats here in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1433:details:3: BSpeak to him, and he will guide you in his designs.
rows.quest:1433:completion:0: Ah, yes. Aid from those loyal to the Warchief is always appreciated.
rows.quest:1433:completion:1: BMy name is Maurin. I am here at the behest of Keldran and the Warchief cub Thrall. It is my desire to aid the youngling leader against the evils that threaten his rule.
rows.quest:1433:completion:2: BCome, come closer, ⟦11⟧. I shall explain to you my plan for removing the festering boil that is the Burning Blade.
rows.quest:1434:obj:0: Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1434:details:0: A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.
rows.quest:1434:details:1: BIt may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.
rows.quest:1434:details:2: BTies have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
rows.quest:1434:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦12⟧. You have shown honor and dedication.
rows.quest:1434:completion:1: BWhen our campaign in ⟦E12⟧ is done, the Warchief will know that you aided us in our actions here, and that you helped make his will manifest.
rows.quest:1435:obj:0: Return the ⟦E15⟧ and 15 Infused Burning Gems to Maurin Bonesplitter in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1435:details:0: Death is most desirable for those despicable creatures that turn their back on their liege for such selfish reasons. But death is not enough when dealing with those that have given themselves over to the darkness.
rows.quest:1435:details:1: BTake this gem. When one of the Burning Blade's near death, activate its magic. The spell shall pull the corrupted spirit out of its victim, leaving an infused gem behind.
rows.quest:1435:details:2: BBring me these infused gems so I may dispose of them properly.
rows.quest:1435:details:3: BGo now, and may you elude death.
rows.quest:1435:completion:0: Ah, you've returned successful. That is good. Give me the gems and I shall put them someplace safe....
rows.quest:1435:completion:1: BMy tasks for you are complete, ⟦13⟧. Speak to Takata when you are rested. He may have other tasks for you, or perhaps needs you to return to ⟦E1⟧ to inform Keldran of our progress here in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:1436:details:0: The fight goes well, ⟦14⟧. Perhaps the Warchief will allow us to return to our homes before the seasons change if we continue to make such great strides in our battle against the demons and their underlings.
rows.quest:1436:details:1: BReturn to Keldran and let him know what we have done. I am sure he will reward you for your efforts here. His cause is important to him, and he will take pride in knowing that the Warchief respects his concerns.
rows.quest:1436:completion:0: You have returned from ⟦E12⟧ more than successful, ⟦15⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:1436:completion:1: BThank you for your efforts, your time, and your understanding to my plea. Thrall understands and desires peace between the ⟦E3⟧ and ⟦E5⟧, and by taking measures to insure our appearance is acceptable, we will not provoke any further threats of unnecessary violence.
rows.quest:2950:obj:0: Bring the Brilliant Gold Ring, a Silver Bar, a Moss Agate, and 30 silver coins to Nogg in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2950:details:0: No, no, no - I'm not all of the sudden saying that the ring is mine. I normally don't do this, but your information about the Dark Irons was very useful. I'll improve your ring for you, better than whomever made this simple little thing could have ever done. Probably some gnome...
rows.quest:2950:details:1: BIf you bring me a bar of silver, a moss agate, and thirty silver coins for my trouble, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will strengthen the magic inside of it. Interested?
rows.quest:2950:completion:0: Here's your ring, better than before. Thanks again for the information about those Dark Iron dwarves. This seems like a reasonable lead as to how those gnomes suddenly were struck with goblin-like inspiration.
rows.quest:2981:obj:0: Belgrom Rockmaul wants you to speak with Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
rows.quest:2981:details:0: ⟦E16⟧ is an ideal location for an accomplished ⟦16⟧ to prove ⟦17⟧. A tribe of ogres called the Gordunni are the dominant military force there, and their numbers are growing. They must be stopped before they threaten our presence in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:2981:details:1: BA warrior I know of named Rok Orhan resides at Camp Mojache in ⟦E16⟧; go to her. She will tell you more of the situation when you arrive.
rows.quest:2981:completion:0: So, Belgrom sent you. You are just in time, ⟦18⟧.
rows.quest:2981:completion:1: BLet me explain the situation, and then you can decide if you are up to the challenge... But if Belgrom sent you, I am sure your courage is unquestionable.
rows.quest:3504:obj:0: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:3504:details:0: Betraying, thieving woman! That's what I call her--that's all she'll ever be!
rows.quest:3504:details:1: BI may have made a grave mistake, ⟦19⟧. I trusted a blood elf. What's worse, I trusted a woman!
rows.quest:3504:details:2: BShe claimed ⟦E17⟧ would hold great riches... powerful items. I simply send some warriors with her to protect her and I would be rewarded. Well, look who's the fool--she's killed them all.
rows.quest:3504:details:3: BI want vengeance, ⟦20⟧, but I can't afford to send anyone else. Find Ag'tor at Valormok, north of the Haldarr Encampment. He'll tell you more.
rows.quest:3504:completion:0: We've sent everything we had at her and her workers, but they are strong in battle. None have bothered to return. I'm assuming some have died, but I'm sure others simply ran... cowards.
rows.quest:3504:completion:1: BBut now that reinforcements have arrived, perhaps there's still something we can do. Perhaps we can still punish her for lying and betraying Belgrom.
rows.quest:3504:completion:2: BWhat do you say, are you in?
rows.quest:3505:obj:0: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori's camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.
rows.quest:3505:details:1: BWe start our crusade against her workers along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula of ⟦E17⟧. Kill them with bloody rage--let them know they've betrayed the wrong allies.
rows.quest:3505:details:2: BDo not concern yourself with her yet--she spends most of her time with her bodyguards searching ⟦E17⟧. It would be prudent after you've slain her workers to find her personal camp. Scouting out where we can attack her would be wise. Perhaps there is something there we can use to provoke her.
rows.quest:3505:completion:0: You begin to skim some of the pages until you come to a page that's marked by a thin, black strip of ⟦E18⟧ cloth.
rows.quest:3505:completion:1: BAs you try to decipher the script, you see a diagram on the bottom of one of the pages. A quick look around at the scene before you and you realize that the crystals, the circle, and even some of the other components on the ground are set up in a similar pattern as the diagram.
rows.quest:3506:obj:0: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:3506:details:0: A few more moments of thought brings a few ideas to mind, one of which brings a smile to your face: perhaps destroying the crystals would upset the blood elf responsible for the slaughter of so many orcs and the betrayal of Belgrom?
rows.quest:3506:details:1: BYou continue to decipher more of the script and pictures and realize that one of the crystals is tied to the creator of the circle--the others are tied to something far more sinister.
rows.quest:3506:details:2: BYou close the book and begin to decide which crystal to destroy.
rows.quest:3506:completion:1: BYou've done it! Belgrom will be pleased! Finally the spirits of dozens of our warriors can be at peace. Thank you, ⟦21⟧.
rows.quest:3507:details:0: Return to Belgrom in ⟦E1⟧. He will want to see her head for himself! We'll return there shortly.
rows.quest:3507:details:1: BAh, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:3507:completion:0: HAHA! Look at you now, pathetic woman! I spit on your remains!
rows.quest:3507:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦23⟧. Thank you from the bottom of my heart! This is indeed a great day!
rows.quest:3507:completion:2: BI would give you a kingdom if it were in my power! But perhaps you will settle for this.
rows.quest:3507:completion:3: B<Belgrom looks down at the head of the mage who had betrayed him.>
rows.quest:3507:completion:4: BHaha! Stupid blood elf, look at you now... in a burlap sack and missing your body! You should never have betrayed Belgrom!
rows.quest:4300:obj:0: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4300:details:0: Hmm, maybe there be somethin' you can do for the Hand now that me think 'bout it. Yes, Jes'rimon could use your help for sure.
rows.quest:4300:details:1: BIn ⟦E19⟧ there be raptors with deadly claws. Some of those raptors sometimes have white claws instead of ones black like death. The Hand have... clients... that like weapons crafted from these claws. Bring me many of those white claws, and me pay you good coin. Do it fast enough, and maybe me help you in other ways.
rows.quest:4300:completion:0: Ah, these do nicely. Thank you, ⟦24⟧. An' you be here long before they needed... that be good.
rows.quest:4300:completion:1: BMaybe we have a weapon fashioned for you from the claws. What do you say?
rows.quest:4494:obj:0: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:4494:details:0: It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:4494:details:1: BWhat we've seen to date is but the first stages. I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in ⟦E8⟧: ⟦E19⟧. Go to Gadgetzan in the ⟦E9⟧ desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg. Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.
rows.quest:4494:completion:0: Yes, I gathered that Zilzibin sent you to me. Your experience in fighting these beasties is priceless; no one to my knowledge has ever dealt with their kind before. As for Zil's idea that ⟦E19⟧ is their heart... perhaps it is. Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here. Perhaps it is also one step closer to figuring out what the silithid are all about.
rows.quest:4511:obj:0: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4511:details:0: ⟦25⟧, we could not have gotten this far without you. The time will come soon, no doubt, when I'll ask for your help against the silithid once more. We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.
rows.quest:4511:details:1: BTake this note to Karus at the bank. He'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. Thank you for your assistance, mighty ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:4511:completion:0: This bank voucher authorizes me to withdraw an item from Zilzibin Drumlore's account with us and present it to you. Congratulations would seem to be in order!
rows.quest:4941:obj:0: Speak with Eitrigg in ⟦E1⟧. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
rows.quest:4941:obj:1: BYou recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.
rows.quest:4941:details:2: BIt had been thought that ⟦E21⟧ was slain decades ago.
rows.quest:4941:details:3: BSeek out the wisdom of Eitrigg, ⟦27⟧. None know the workings of the Blackrock better than he and if what is written here bares truth, Eitrigg should be informed. No person should be denied the right of vengeance.
rows.quest:4941:details:5: BOnce you have spoken with Eitrigg, confer with the Warchief to find out what he wishes to do about this problem.
rows.quest:4941:completion:0: <Thrall appears dismayed by the news you bring.>
rows.quest:5726:obj:0: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5726:details:0: One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, ⟦28⟧. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.
rows.quest:5726:details:1: BBut you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.
rows.quest:5726:details:2: BIf you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of ⟦E1⟧, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
rows.quest:5726:completion:0: Good, ⟦29⟧! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.
rows.quest:5726:completion:1: BBut there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
rows.quest:5727:obj:0: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5727:details:0: Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.
rows.quest:5727:details:1: BThere is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.
rows.quest:5727:details:2: BTake this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in ⟦E1⟧, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
rows.quest:5727:completion:1: BWhat you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the ⟦E22⟧ on, once and for all.
rows.quest:5727:completion:2: BTell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.
rows.quest:5729:details:0: I think our next step should be to have you placed close to Neeru. If he is as agitated as reports suggest, then we may accomplish two things. One, you may be able to gain some greater knowledge about the Council or at least the Burning Blade, and two, he may just begin to trust you enough that he asks you to start to aid him. He may very well look at you as someone who can fill the void now that some of the leadership is in turmoil.
rows.quest:5729:details:1: BReturn to the Cleft and speak to him again, but do not be too overt.
rows.quest:5729:completion:0: What is it?! Oh, you, ⟦31⟧... my apologies. My anger rivals that of a rabid kodo bull... but perhaps it is my own fault. In sending travelers into Ragefire Chasm, I should have seen the possibility that some harm would come from it. It seems both Bazzalan and Jergosh were taken unaware and slain by some of Thrall's do-gooders. A most inopportune time, but there is nothing that can be done about it now.
rows.quest:5730:obj:0: Speak to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧ and tell him what you've learned.
rows.quest:5730:details:0: You are one of my lieutenants! Prepare yourself, ⟦32⟧. I will call upon you soon.
rows.quest:5730:details:1: BMy time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the ⟦E22⟧'s schemes elsewhere must suffer. I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the ⟦E4⟧ and ⟦E2⟧ begin work on our newest agenda. Return to me soon.
rows.quest:5730:completion:0: ⟦E2⟧? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in ⟦E2⟧. My spies will investigate, ⟦33⟧. You have done well.
rows.quest:5730:completion:1: BFor now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.
rows.quest:6566:details:0: It is good to see you again, ⟦34⟧. The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom.
rows.quest:6566:completion:0: Are you prepared to take on this task?
rows.quest:6567:obj:0: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of ⟦E12⟧, between the ⟦E14⟧ and ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:6567:details:0: I have received word from one of my champions that a way into the lair of the dragon may exist. You are to seek him out.
rows.quest:6567:details:1: BRexxar wanders the desert wasteland of ⟦E12⟧, traveling between Stonetalon and ⟦E16⟧. He awaits your arrival.
rows.quest:6567:completion:0: There is but one way into the dragon's lair, ⟦36⟧.
rows.quest:6567:completion:1: BYou see, only the strongest of the Black Dragonflight are allowed entry into the lair of the brood mother. Many trials must be passed and the key to enter ceremoniously enchanted by General Drakkisath himself!
rows.quest:6567:completion:2: BSince you are not of black dragonkin, you may have some difficulty in obtaining passage.
rows.quest:7490:obj:0: Take the Head of ⟦E23⟧ to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7490:details:0: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to your Warchief.
rows.quest:7490:completion:0: This is a great victory for the ⟦E3⟧, ⟦38⟧. So many times you have honored your Warchief. It is time for the Warchief to honor you.
rows.quest:7491:obj:0: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.
rows.quest:7491:details:0: Overlord Runthak awaits your arrival in the Valley of Strength.
rows.quest:7491:details:2: BDo not keep your public waiting, hero.
rows.quest:7491:completion:0: Choose your reward and let the celebration of your glorious victory begin.
rows.quest:7493:completion:0: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
rows.quest:7493:completion:1: BPlease accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:7493:completion:2: BCreate the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... ⟦E24⟧.
rows.quest:7783:obj:0: Return the Head of ⟦E24⟧ to Thrall in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7783:details:0: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of ⟦E24⟧. Return it to your Warchief, champion.
rows.quest:7783:completion:0: You have honored the ⟦E3⟧ once more, ⟦40⟧. The son of ⟦E25⟧ lays dead. Surely, the evil one stirs.
rows.quest:7784:obj:0: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in ⟦E1⟧. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.
rows.quest:7784:details:0: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.
rows.quest:7784:completion:0: Choose your reward so that I may mount the head of the beast for all to see.
rows.quest:7824:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
rows.quest:7824:completion:1: BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
rows.quest:7826:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦41⟧!
